decision.context: Response to proposed unified brand standard for every post; A and B are applications of one house style.
decision.scope: Record agreed brand direction and apply to reusable templates. No approval of unrendered assets, exact design parameters or publication.
decision.source: Direct Nitin message in this conversation, 2026-09-27 19:13 Europe/Amsterdam

identity.positioning: A Western Sound with Eastern Soul
identity.positioning_usage: Bio, campaign copy and longer closing variants; do not stack every slogan on each video.

palette.exact_values: Resolve from authoritative existing brand assets; record color-space-aware values and validate in actual HLG output. No newly invented hex values treated as approved.

typography.supporting_copy: Montserrat Regular or Medium where hierarchy requires
typography.size_baseline: R2 enlarged typography as starting point; verify real glyph dimensions and mobile readability per layout, not a universal fixed size.

logo.full_lockup: Reuse existing authoritative full lockup; verify original file and provenance/hash. Do not recreate or falsely claim verification.
logo.monogram: Existing UN monogram only at intro/outro

visual.motion: Musically timed text entrances and continuous rhythmic performance editing; effect strength and exact motion settings remain reviewable.

post_structure.opening: Performance starts immediately with short hook or song title; no prolonged logo intro.
post_structure.performance: Selective large captions; preserve face, mouth, expression and performance-first composition. Do not require continuous captions.
post_structure.ending: Short consistent full lockup/brand ending with UNCHAINED NITIN and THE INDESTRUCTIBLE VOICE.
post_structure.cover: Consistent song-title/brand-lockup composition, adapted to target crop.
post_structure.static_posts: Apply same palette, typography and verified lockup; intro/outro rules apply only to moving media.

template_roles.relationship: Complementary components of same house style, not competing brand identities.
template_roles.exact_copy_timing_and_combination: Not yet final-asset approved; demonstrate in integrated preview.

required_qc: Mobile legibility and no face/mouth obstruction
Platform-specific safe areas verified; do not equate generic margins with platform compliance
HLG/10-bit and exact source/color binding preserved for current Aakhri workflow
Cache invalidation includes brand standard, logo/font hashes and styling
Review actual integrated output before final approval
implementation_contract.next_action: Local factory: resolve authoritative logo and exact palette, bind this versioned standard to template/config, demonstrate complete branding in bounded Aakhri preview. Reuse R2 components and existing audio/footage. Persist assets on authoritative Shared Drive and code/evidence in GitHub with readback. No new purchases, frozen-component changes or full-master render.

governance.reason: Existing ledger/reducer and pointer integrity hold; this is additive brand decision evidence, not Master State promotion.
